items.title: Ernest 'Punch' Miller Interview, 1959-09-25
items.q: I was expecting a letter from this fellow I used to work with, McBride.

ctx.x: What about, what would they do to you in Georgia, Mississippi? Do you have any experiences with them?

Well, no, I'm gonna tell you the truth. No, because I've never had no trouble in places. I always was, you know, stayed where I was supposed to stay and kept in the right places, you know, where I was belonging. I never did mingle up in places where I had no business, you know what I mean? I was telling them one insult I remember getting one time, that was in Florida though. I was expecting a letter from this fellow I used to work with, McBride. And, you know, I told him just write to the post office and I'd go…
